tools.name: search_telegram
tools.description: Full-text search over the tgden catalog (1.3M+ channels, 254k+ group chats, 164k+ bots) with subscriber/member counts, categories and trust scores. Needs no Telegram account — this is the public catalog, so it finds communities the user has NOT joined. Use type to restrict to one entity kind.

tools.name: channel_stats
tools.description: Full record for one channel by @username: subscribers, category, language, trust score, description.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search over recent posts from catalogued channels (1k+ view posts). Returns text snippets, channel and view counts.

tools.name: market_listings
tools.description: Fresh classified listings extracted from Telegram groups across the OTC network — Thailand (th), UAE (ae), Turkey (tr), Vietnam (vn), Georgia (ge), USA (us), Russia (ru): rent, sale, services, jobs, exchange. Filter by country and listing type.

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: Listing totals by country and type for the OTC marketplace (th·ae·tr·vn·ge·us·ru).

tools.name: best_channels_by_category
tools.description: Top Telegram channels ranked by subscribers for a given category. Use this when someone asks 'best telegram channels for [topic]' or 'top channels about [subject]'. Returns channel name, @username, subscriber count, language and description.
